text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile CS! Trainer, this will be the 
ultimate culmination of our mile races!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's usually held at Kyoto Racecourse 
every year, but it's at Hanshin this year!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The reason is... apparently because the 
Kyoto stands are undergoing some 
maintenance. But...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A mile is a mile on any racetrack! And I'm 
the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her optimal distance after conquering 
three different divisions. At this point, 
course differences are trivial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How well can she run at the mile right 
now? Just imagining it makes the 
excitement bubble up inside me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I'll deliver the best run of my 
life!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Tons of racing fans have come to watch, 
of course, but—)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so that's Gran Alegria-chan. She's so 
cute~!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Let's take lots of photos! Smile, smile~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
New racing fans! And somehow, the numbers 
are shooting way up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I want to show these people! The new style 
of mile racing that lies beyond conquering 
all three categories!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I can—do it. I'm finally just 0.1 miles 
away from pulling it off!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"If people see that running, they'll 
surely fall in love with racing even 
more!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And even more than a new way of running— 
to Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, to my potential right now—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Dream a brand-new dream that no one has 
ever seen before!"
